facts.fact: Adwave buys media on streaming TV, Meta, Google Search, YouTube, Reddit and the web from a prepaid wallet, starting at $30 a day, according to Adwave.
facts.quote: it buys media on streaming TV, Meta, Google Search, YouTube, Reddit and the web from a prepaid wallet, starting at $30 a day

facts.fact: Adwave says every tool that spends is marked destructive, so the host app asks the user first.
facts.quote: Every tool that spends is marked destructive, so the host app asks first.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, Adwave runs campaigns only in the US and Canada.
facts.quote: Adwave runs campaigns in the US and Canada only.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, TikTok is opt-in early access and Pinterest is coming soon as campaign channels.
facts.quote: TikTok is opt-in early access, Pinterest is coming soon

facts.fact: Per OpenAI's help article as cited by Adwave, ChatGPT gives custom MCP servers full write access only on Business and Enterprise workspaces.
facts.quote: ChatGPT, for example, gives custom servers full write access only on Business and Enterprise workspaces

facts.fact: Adwave's guide was last updated on November 3, 2026.
